explanations.answer: What is worth doing in life
explanations.explanation: That's what he's after. He keeps at it “…until I could see what was worthwhile for men to do under heaven during the few days of their lives.” He's not just having fun, friend, he's hunting for something that's worth doing. And he says the days are few, so I think he doesn't want to waste them.
